note: WHICH COLUMNS HAVE ACTUALLY BEEN READ AT MIGNE'S PLATE. Written 2026-08-28, the day 9003's full collation showed our Corpus Corporum Latin departs from the plate at ~3 sites per page against a standing corpus estimate of THREE INSTANCES IN TOTAL. This file exists so that `scripts/plate-gate.mjs` can refuse a [sic:] or a [var:] on a column nobody has read. It records READS, not findings: a range belongs here when someone put the page on screen, read the corner numbers first, and read the running text -- whether or not anything was found. Its opposite number is data/plate-notes/coverage.json, which records only the foot-of-page conjecture layer. || 2026-08-29: extended by the [sic:] plate sweep across PL 113/114/202 — 56 pages, 80 markers, ledger at data/plate-sweep/2026-08-29-sic-sweep.tsv. ⛔ 8988 col 0636A is DELIBERATELY NOT RECORDED: the page was read, but the word (aurursus / aut / au) sits in the extreme right margin where that scan has ink bleed and could not be resolved. Leaving it unrecorded keeps the gate flagging that marker, which is the honest state — a read that could not settle the word is not a read for this purpose.
why_the_gate: A [sic:] asserts a defect in MIGNE'S TYPE and a [var:] asserts that MIGNE'S TEXT diverges from a scriptural witness. Both are public claims about the printed page. Our Latin is not the printed page -- it is Corpus Corporum's transcription of it -- so neither claim can be licensed by the file alone. Corpus frequency detects that an error EXISTS; it cannot say WHOSE it is (reference_plate-read-triage.md). Vulgate collation is worse than useless for the [var:] class: 9003 @0763D showed the digitization MANUFACTURING a divergence (judicabit -> judicavit) that the collation then dutifully 'found'.
rule: NOT A RETROFIT (CLAUDE.md, "RECOVER GOING FORWARD, DO NOT SWEEP THE DONE CORPUS"). The gate is a SHIP TEST: run it on a work before marking it `ours`. Works shipped before 2026-08-28 are surveyed by `--all`, which measures the exposure and exits zero; the number it prints is evidence for a decision about sample width, not a mandate to re-open 38 books.
